description: This Java class provides helper methods for applying tenant-specific trace sampling configuration in an Eclipse Hono service. It determines and applies trace sampling priorities based on tenant configuration and integrates with tracing spans.

classes.name: TenantTraceSamplingHelper
classes.description: A utility final class to determine and apply trace sampling priorities for tenants based on their configuration.

methods.name: getTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the trace sampling priority for a tenant object with auth ID, returning an OptionalInt.

methods.name: applyTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Applies the trace sampling priority to a given tracing span based on tenant configuration.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Private method that retrieves the sampling mode for a tenant based on its tracing configuration.

methods.name: getSamplingPriority
methods.description: Private method that converts a TracingSamplingMode enum value into an OptionalInt priority.
